messages:
olivia_marketing: Heads-up — launching a small experiment today on the pricing page: testing two FAQ accordion treatments + anchor CTAs that route inbound leads differently. Plan: A = compact single-line FAQ with 'Contact sales' anchor -> sales@redwood; B = expanded Q+A with 'Get pricing estimate' anchor -> inline estimator form. Goal: improve conversion to paid trial and reduce low-quality leads. Details doc: https://redwood.app/internal/faq-accordion-expt (internal)

ben_growth: love it. quick q: what metric do we prioritize? SQLs or funnel conversion to trial?

olivia_marketing: priority = SQL rate first (we need better lead quality), secondary = FAQ click-through to calculator. Use weighted metric: SQL_rate (70%) / CTR_calc (30%).

nina_product: UX note — if we add the expanded Q+A (B) we should surface the calculator embed inline to avoid extra page loads. embedding snippet below.

olivia_marketing: paste embed so design/dev can check.

nina_product: ```
<iframe src="https://app.redwood-inference.com/price-estimator?variant=B&embed=1" width="100%" height="420"></iframe>
```

chris_research: I ran a quick cohort sim on last 30 days: users from docs have 1.8x higher activation after filling estimator. i'll attach numbers in sheets: https://sheets.redwood/research/estimator-cohort (internal)

tom_sales: if variant B increases estimator usage, make sure leads get routed to /sales/estimator-review queue (not public inbound). we don't want noise in top-level SDR inbox.

olivia_marketing: routing mapping:
- variant A CTA -> sales@redwood (SDR triage)
- variant B CTA -> estimator-claims-form -> lead-router-bot -> sales/estimator-review

lead-router-bot: new routing rule deployed for experiment id exp-2026-03-22-01. Config excerpt:
```
{
  "experiment": "exp-2026-03-22-01",
  "variantA_route": "sales@redwood",
  "variantB_route": "estimator-queue"
}
```

ben_growth: timeline?

olivia_marketing: roll out to 10% traffic at 10:00 PDT today, monitor first 6 hours. Can increase to 50% if no negative signal. Dashboard: /dashboards/marketing/faq-accordion-expt

nina_product: small copy options for the anchor CTAs. vote pls.
- A1: "Contact sales"
- A2: "Talk to sales about latency & pricing"
- B1: "Get your custom estimate"
- B2: "Estimate my monthly cost"

chris_research: my pick B1 (more action-oriented), A2 seems too long on page.

tom_sales: prefer A1 to keep it simple for SDRs. B2 maybe better for self-serve clarity.

olivia_marketing: quick poll: react with :one: for A1, :two: for A2, :three: for B1, :four: for B2 by 9:30 PT.

ben_growth: :three:

nina_product: :three:

tom_sales: :one:

olivia_marketing: thanks 🙏 will update copy and ping design for microcopy placement.

ben_growth: after 6 hours let's huddle in #marketing-standup (9:30 PT) if there's signal.

olivia_marketing: noted. I'll post interim numbers to this thread and the dashboard feed.

lead-router-bot: experiment exp-2026-03-22-01 traffic split: A: 50 users, B: 50 users so far. No errors.

olivia_marketing: awesome. thanks team.
